item.title: 18k-Mile 2002 Chevrolet Corvette Z06
item.description: This 2002 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 is finished in Electron Blue Metallic over Black leather and has 18k miles following history in Ohio, Kentucky, and California. It is powered by a 405-horsepower 5.7-liter LS6 V8 linked to a six-speed manual gearbox and a limited-slip differential. The car is equipped with pop-up headlights, 17" and 18" wheels, a head-up display, a titanium exhaust, a Bose sound system, and a power-adjustable driver's seat with memory settings. item.title: 1958 Chevrolet Bel Air 2-Door Sport Coupe 348
item.description: This 1958 Chevrolet Bel Air two-door Sport Coupe is powered by a 348ci V8 paired with a two-speed Powerglide automatic transmission, and the engine was disassembled and rebuilt in 2019. The body is finished in white and light aqua, and the car is equipped with chrome wire-spoke wheels, whitewall tires, curb feelers, power-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, and a dual exhaust system. Cabin appointments include a split front bench seat, metal dashboard trim, an AM radio, a heater, and a swamp cooler

item.title: 7k-Mile 2017 Porsche 911 Carrera Coupe 7-Speed
item.description: This 2017 Porsche 911 Carrera is a Guards Red-finished coupe that was purchased new by the owner and was optioned with a seven-speed manual transaxle, which is paired with a twin-turbocharged 3.0L flat-six. Having 7k miles, the car is further equipped with Luxor Beige leather upholstery, 19" Carrera alloy wheels, a glass sunroof, parking sensors, bi-xenon headlights, heated power-adjustable front seats, Voice Control, and dual-zone automatic climate control. item.title: 264-Mile 2008 Ferrari F430 Spider
item.description: This 2008 Ferrari F430 Spider has 264 miles, and it was ordered new by philanthropist and car collector Michael Fux. The car remained in his collection until January 2025. It is finished in Rosso Corsa over beige leather with red stitching and is powered by a 4.3-liter DOHC V8 paired with a six-speed F1 automated transaxle. item.title: 18k-Mile 2018 Porsche 911 GT3 6-Speed
item.description: This 2018 Porsche 911 GT3 was purchased new by the current owner from Rusnak Porsche in Pasadena, California, and it now has 18k miles.
